description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate from Oracle Database to Azure Database for PostgreSQL with managed identity authentication
tasks.requirements: Migrate the Photo Album application database from Oracle Database XE 21c to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The migration must include: (1) Database schema migration - convert Oracle-specific DDL and data types to PostgreSQL equivalents, including BLOB to BYTEA conversion for photo storage; (2) Convert all Oracle-specific SQL queries in PhotoRepository (including native queries using ROWNUM, TO_CHAR, and analytical functions) to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax; (3) Update JDBC driver from ojdbc8 to PostgreSQL JDBC driver; (4) Configure Spring Boot to use PostgreSQL dialect instead of OracleDialect; (5) Implement managed identity authentication for secure, credential-free database access using Azure SDK; (6) Update application.properties with PostgreSQL connection configuration; (7) Maintain all existing functionality including photo upload, retrieval, deletion, and navigation features; (8) Ensure backward compatibility with existing data structures and API contracts. Authentication method: Managed Identity (Azure-native, secure, credential-free).
